تحتكروا (form VIII)
# تَحْتَكِرُوا (taḥtakirū) /taħ.ta.ki.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
# تُحْتَكَرُوا (tuḥtakarū) /tuħ.ta.ka.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
